player_prompt.intro:
Ame {player_id} nye xɔxɔtɔ {colour} ({piece}) le Othello ƒe eme ŋu.
Dɔ wòaxɔ nye be na wòazu xɔxɔtɔ siwo tɔ ŋgɔ na mɔ le tɛtɛ ŋu le eme ƒe nuvɔ̃lia me.
Le wòaxɔ me, tsɔ xɔxɔtɔ sia eye wòado xɔxɔtɔ bubu siwo nye mɔtɔwo le ƒe mɔɖeɖe (gbɔgbɔ, yɔyɔ, alo gɔgɔme) le wòaxɔ xɔxɔtɔ ƒe kɔkɔme.
Xɔxɔtɔ siwo wòado ƒe mɔtɔwo ƒe xɔxɔtɔ siwo tɔ ŋgɔ na mɔ le wòaxɔ xɔxɔtɔ ƒe kɔkɔme.
Dɔ wòaxɔ wòasrɔ ƒe mɔɖeɖe le '[row, col]' ƒe ŋkɔme.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Ʋu si sɔ mele eme o - ɖewohĩ ahiã be nàɖe asi le eŋu.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Ʋuɖeɖe aɖeke meli o. Àte ŋu aɖi ʋua dzi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ele be woazã [row, col] ƒe nɔnɔme.
invalid_move.illegal: Ʋu si mele se nu o. Ʋu siwo sɔ: {valid}

game_action.skipped: Ele na fefewɔla {pid} be wòada eƒe gamea dzi.
game_action.played: Aɖa {pid} ({piece}) wɔ dɔ le [{r}, {c}] ku {flipped} dzidzi(wo)

game_message.must_skip: Xɔxɔtɔ {pid} ({piece}) mɛnye mɔɖeɖe siwo wòaxɔ wòasrɔ eye wòado nɔnɔ.
